create_bytes_tokenizer: create a BytesTokenizer instance to tokenize strings into UTF-8 byte tokens
convert_string_to_int_tokens: convert a string to an int32 numpy array of byte tokens using to_int
convert_int_tokens_to_string: convert an int32 numpy array of byte tokens back to a string using to_string
get_vocab_size: get the total vocabulary size including 256 bytes plus 6 reserved special tokens
get_special_token_ids: get the integer IDs for special tokens like PAD, BOS, EOS, MASK, CLS, and SEP
